breadboard_layout.basis: user-authorized planning envelope, not assembled measurement
breadboard_layout.retention_note: Side rims locate only. Edge clips require actual plastic-base height and free contact areas; no pressure on components is designed.
breadboard_layout.arc_modules: excluded from this layout; no lower-body relocation

negative_controls.case: height increased by 5 mm hits crown

breadboard_check.limits: Envelope and rigid tray only. No individual audio/display/USB/RF fit, hand access, flexible harness service, material strength or anti-lift retention acceptance.

component_readback.local_axes: length X, width Y, height Z; origin at minimum corner
component_readback.geometry: single full rectangular envelope; no inferred holes or internal details

l298n_layout.mounting: vertical candidate between motors; removable cassette added by l298n_mount; PCB contact still unverified

removal.method: exact rectangular continuous sweep, 80 mm down
removal.disconnect_first: actual driver leads; release modeled cassette mounting screws when present

limits: Dimensions inclusion, PCB corner contacts and exact terminal positions remain unverified.
Minimum nominal gaps are not thermal, insulation, tolerance or physical acceptance.
Bare envelope checked with co-moving cassette removed from obstacles; see mount check for complete cassette, screws and tool shafts; real wires/fingers remain unverified.

l298n_mount.mount_method: open cassette with four adjustable edge-pressure pads; no assumed PCB mounting-hole pattern
interface_assumptions: PCB lower-edge and corner contact regions require actual confirmation.
Overall supplied height may or may not include solder tails; no protrusion height inferred.
Screw sizes, pad thicknesses and connector corridors are proposed design values.

cassette_removal.method: 80 mm downward continuous conservative union of primitive boxes; all final carrier material contained
cassette_removal.disconnect_first: motor, power and control wires; connectors and flexible service loops are not measured

bench_board_removal.method: 80 mm up after cassette removed from robot and side pads released

carrier_export.coordinate_frame: assembly coordinates, no scale or relocation

ultrasonic_check.datum_description: candidate PCB front face; user panel datum not confirmed

module_removal.method: continuous box sweeps for cuboids; exact axial/capsule sweeps for full probe cylinders

ultrasonic_integration_check.limits: Unmeasured PCB, datum, rear height, header, connector, wire bend and board endpoint. No mounts or hand access acceptance.

ignition_routing_layout.location: inboard over motor deck; enters front bay at shoulder, exits front face

ignition_routing_check.scope: geometric allocation only; no electrical or installation acceptance
ignition_routing_check.representation: connected straight clearance segments; not manufactured parts

sampled_service_with_corridors.method: 8 discrete poses per straight segment; whole breadboard continuous tray/fastener/tool checks are reported separately in breadboard_check; legacy arc/USB scenarios only exist when those objects are present; no hand access certification

front_effects_layout.basis: 用户2026-10-25指定底盘前方左右各两根线，并补充单线外径1.5 mm；位置、长度及护套仍为外观假设，不是高压线材、电极、放电间距、绝缘或安装规格；不含内部接线

front_effects_check.scope: Static visual solids; guard contact and lead within 2.6 mm exit bore budget; not electrical spacing or fixture validation

mt3608_layout.mounting: allocation only; no fixture or hole pattern inferred

bare_board_removal.method: exact rectangular continuous sweep 90 mm down
bare_board_removal.disconnect_first: MT3608 leads and left-motor/driver wiring; release future fixture
bare_board_removal.prerequisite: Follow existing left motor and L298N removal procedures, including power tray and left track removal.

limits: Overall measured box only; PCB contacts, terminals and adjustment position unmeasured.
End spaces are design budgets, not a complete wiring or adjustment path.
Service requires driver and left motor removal; fixture and physical handling remain unresolved.

effects_layout.quantity_assumption: one MOS and one buck per effect

board_mount.limits: Local candidate wiring only; PCB edges, components, compression, tolerance stack, complete harness and hand access unverified. Frame/board removal is off-machine after tray extraction.
